name: ClickSyncr for Loops – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms & Formidable
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Loops connects your forms to Loops, so every form submission becomes a contact in your Loops mailing list: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Loops connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Loops” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Loops.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Loops API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your mailing lists load automatically: choose which Loops mailing list new contacts join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any contact property: send first name, last name, and every custom contact property you have created in Loops, straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: pick a consent checkbox from your form and ClickSyncr syncs the contact only when a visitor ticks it.
  • Subscribed status control: decide whether new contacts arrive subscribed, per form.
  • No duplicate contacts: Loops matches contacts by email, so existing contacts are updated and new ones are created, every single time.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Loops mailing list with its own property mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Loops sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Loops, and to which mailing list.

Learn more about the forms to Loops integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Loops account with an API key

Getting your Loops API key

  1. Log in to your Loops account.
  2. Go to Settings > API.
  3. Generate a new API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Loops settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Loops

Connected forms send their submissions to Loops. Read more in the Loops privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Loops”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr Loops settings.
  2. Paste your Loops API key, choose a mailing list, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Loops automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr for Loops page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Loops account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Loops account and an API key to sync your contacts.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Loops API key?

Log in to Loops and go to Settings > API, then generate a new API key. The ClickSyncr for Loops page shows exactly where to paste it.

Which fields can I map?

Map your form fields to your Loops contact properties: first name, last name, and every custom property you have created in your Loops account.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. The contact is sent to Loops only when a visitor ticks it. Leave it as “None” to sync every valid submission.

Will it create duplicate contacts?

No. Loops matches contacts by email address: existing contacts are updated and new ones are created.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr Loops setup, so each can sync to a different mailing list.

ClickSyncr for Loops Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Loops. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
